verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents scenario modeling that covers hypothetical future rounds, exportable scenarios, and Internal Rate of Return and cash-on-cash calculations. Those return metrics suggest some exit-proceeds analysis, but the evidence never describes an exit waterfall. Missing for 10: explicit exit waterfall modeling across exit values, proceeds broken out per share class and per stakeholder, handling of liquidation preferences and participation, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
